app.name: FastAPI
app.one_liner: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance Python web framework for building APIs with automatic validation, serialization, and interactive documentation based on standard Python type hints.

screens.name: Interactive API Documentation
screens.purpose: Provide auto-generated, interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation for all defined API endpoints.
primary_actions: Test API calls directly in browser

rust_commands.name: serve_api
rust_commands.purpose: Start the FastAPI application server to handle HTTP requests and serve the API with auto-generated documentation.

mvp_plan: week 1: Define core routing and dependency injection system
week 1: Embed Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation
week 1: Generate OpenAPI spec from type annotations
week 1: Integrate Pydantic for request/response validation
acceptance_tests: Interactive documentation (Swagger UI) is accessible at /docs and reflects defined endpoints
Request validation rejects malformed input based on Pydantic models
The application starts successfully and serves an OpenAPI-compliant specification at /openapi.json
Type hints on function parameters correctly generate path/query/body parameter schemas
